title: 28-Layer Stack with Expanded SiO2 Initialization and Variance Regularization
scientific_hypothesis: Expanding low-index (SiO2) layer initialization bounds by ±25% while freezing high-index (HfO2) layers near their observed optimal cluster (150-200 nm) will increase the probability of landing within the dual-band feasible basin, and adding mild thickness variance regularization between adjacent layers will reduce numerically unstable oscillatory solutions that consume computational budget.
design_principle: Asymmetric initialization strategy: SiO2 layers initialized with wider bounds to explore thickness space more thoroughly, HfO2 layers initialized near converged values from iteration_07 to preserve learned optima. Variance penalty discourages abrupt thickness jumps that cause numerical convergence issues.
proposed_topology: 28 finite layers on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 HfO2 + 14 SiO2). No protective capping layer specified.
design_variables: all 28 layer thicknesses with asymmetric initialization bounds
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
minimize thickness variance between adjacent layers
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds: HfO2 120-230 nm, SiO2 40-95 nm
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflectance bands
Dual-band filter design requires non-quarter-wave optimization
expected_advantages: Wider SiO2 search space increases feasible basin capture probability
Preserves HfO2 optima from prior iteration
known_risks: Regularization may constrain optimizer from finding global optimum
Wider bounds may increase convergence time
execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer HfO2/SiO2 multilayer coating on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (14 bilayers). Initialize HfO2 layer thicknesses uniformly in range 120-230 nm. Initialize SiO2 layer thicknesses uniformly in range 40-95 nm. Apply gradient-based thickness optimization with objective: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Add regularization penalty proportional to variance of thickness differences between adjacent layers (weight=0.01). Use smatrix solver with unpolarized normal incidence. Total layer count fixed at 28. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: expand SiO2 initialization bounds by ±25% (from ~55-73 nm observed cluster to 40-95 nm), freeze HfO2 near observed optimal cluster (120-230 nm encompasses 150-200 nm), add thickness variance regularization to reduce numerical instability.
